integrity.formula_basis: The classical Pluecker formulas are reconstructed geometrically and compared with full-text modern treatments of projective duality, inflection points, and bitangents.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The modern full-text source arXiv:2204.04626 lists primary MSC 14N10, and the archival source is in Algebraic Geometry.

scientific_limitations: General smooth complex plane curves of degree at least four.
Bitangents and inflection tangents are counted as distinct geometric lines in the generic Pluecker situation.
The theorem concerns the three basic dual-line Pluecker invariants, not higher generalized Pluecker numbers.
An unindexed historical source could contain the same short arithmetic classification.
title: Arithmetic primitivity of the Pluecker triple for a general smooth plane curve
